text:
alex: Heads-up — saw a telemetry gap over the weekend that removed about ~6 hours of GPU usage events from the forecasting pipeline (02:00-08:00 UTC Sat->Sun). Looks like the ingest proxy retried and then dropped a batch.
marta: Ugh. Is this the same path that feeds the daily forecast job? If so we might under-provision next week.
alex: Yes, daily-forecast consumes normalized_usage_events.{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd} from s3 via the ingest-job. Missing partitions for 2027-06-12 02-08 UTC.
sylvain: Any error logs from the producer side? deploy-bot: ingest-proxy v1.12 deployed at 2027-06-11T21:05Z — recent restarts: 2, last restart 2027-06-12T03:14Z.
kim: Looks like transient network flaps to the kafka cluster during that window. I see a bunch of ProduceRequest timeouts in proxy logs.
joel: Do we have dead-letter data? We used to write failed batches to s3://redwood-ingest-failures/ , is that enabled for this stream?
alex: Not for that particular topic. We only enabled DLQ for high-priority topics. This one was marked low-prio to save costs.
marta: That explains why missing. If the pipeline silently drops low-priority events, forecasts bias low during bursty weekends.
sylvain: Two immediate asks: 1) backfill the missing partitions into normalized_usage_events for the window; 2) add an alert when ingest success rate < 99.5% per-hour for any partitioned date.
kim: Agreed. Backfill plan: re-run the kafka-replay job with --from-offset <t1> --to-offset <t2> and write to a backfill prefix, then run normalization job against that prefix.
alex: Example replay command I used previously:
```
./bin/kafka-replay --topic=usage-events --from-ts=2027-06-12T02:00:00Z --to-ts=2027-06-12T08:00:00Z --out=s3://redwood-backfill/usage/2027-06-12-burst
```
kim: Note: when replaying we must set the key mapping so events land in the same partitioning scheme (user_id % 256). Missing that caused duplication last time.
joel: For the alerting piece, propose a Grafana panel and a PagerDuty rule: if ingest_success_rate_hourly < 99.5% for 2 consecutive hours AND forecast_error_delta > 3% spike, page oncall.
marta: Also let's avoid changing paging thresholds for weekends only — we saw a big weekend burst last quarter (gaming customers), so weekend-aware capacity is needed.
sylvain: Longer term: we should enable DLQ writes for this stream with a cheap low-latency lifecycle (30d) and auto-trigger a backfill job when DLQ size > 10k events.
alex: Ops questions: can we tolerate a 1h delay for backfilled data to be visible in the forecast dashboards? Our SLA for daily forecast run is 04:00 UTC.
kim: If backfill completes before 03:30 UTC we'll still hit the daily cadence with a normal recompute. Worst-case we run an ad-hoc recompute at 05:00.
joel: Cost note: replaying 6 hours of events is ~12GB compressed -> ~0.5 GPU-hours in normalize job according to recent runbook numbers. Low impact on cost but high impact on correctness.
marta: OK action items: alex to kick off kafka-replay + normalization to backfill; kim to add ingest success rate alert and DLQ toggle; joel to add Grafana+PD rule and update runbook; sylvain to schedule a postmortem and add weekend-burst test to staging.
alex: I'll start the replay now and post progress here.
alex: 1793422000 — kicked off kafka-replay job, job id replay-20270612-01
kim: Adding alert: created grafana panel "ingest success rate (hour)" dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/ingest/ingest-health
joel: PD rule created: Team=infra-forecasting, severity=high when both conditions met.
alex: 1793423600 — replay job finished. Written backfill to s3://redwood-backfill/usage/2027-06-12-burst (~13.2GB). Starting normalization.
alex: 1793424500 — normalization completed. Recompute kicked for daily-forecast pipeline for 2027-06-12.
sylvain: Great. Can we add a quick check in the forecast job that computes coverage ratio = (ingested_events / expected_events) per-day and emits a metric? If coverage < 98% mark forecast as provisional.
kim: Yep. I'll add a metric ingestion.coverage_ratio with tags {date, region}. We'll emit it to prometheus via pushgateway for now.
joel: Remind to update the SLO doc: forecasts must be flagged provisional if coverage_ratio < 98% or if forecast deviation > 5% from rolling baseline.
marta: Thanks everyone. Putting a reminder to review low-prio topics DLQ policy next quarter.
deploy-bot: NOTE: replay-20270612-01 finished successfully (duration 00:16:42)."
